metadata.title: About FoVR Interactive | Immersive Experience Studio
metadata.description: FoVR Interactive is a Brisbane-based creative studio making virtual reality, mixed reality and interactive experiences.

text.a_creative_studio_with_a_curiosity: A Brisbane studio making immersive experiences.
text.fovr_interactive_makes_virtual_reality_m: We make games and mixed reality experiences you can get hands-on with. FoVR Labs is where we try the ideas that don’t fit in a game yet.
text.matthew_leads_fovrs_technical_direction_: Matthew founded FoVR Interactive and leads the design and development of its experiences, from the first prototype to testing on a headset.
